name: crewforge5
description: CrewForge5 — agent crews as a managed resource, behind three commands: /crewforge5:init, /crewforge5:plan and /crewforge5:execute.

plugins.name: crewforge5
plugins.description: Three commands over one repo: /crewforge5:init audits and slims your Claude config, /crewforge5:plan turns a goal into an adversarially-reviewed plan, and /crewforge5:execute drives that plan to a merged commit with a generated agent crew and its quality gates.
